Write your answer to `answer.txt` in the workspace. Provide a concise, factual answer.

content.thinking:
The user is asking about which awards ceremony Oppenheimer first won the Best Film award. Let me think about this. Oppenheimer (2023) won numerous awards. It won Best Picture at the Academy Awards (Oscars) in March 2024. But it may have won "Best Film" at other ceremonies before that, like BAFTA, which typically happens before the Oscars.

BAFTA Awards 2024 - Oppenheimer won Best Film at the 77th BAFTA Awards held on February 18, 2024.

The Academy Awards (Oscars) - 96th Academy Awards were held on March 10, 2024.


Looking at the timeline of awards ceremonies, I need to check if there were any "Best Film" wins before BAFTA in February. The Golden Globes and Critics' Choice Awards both happened in January, but they use different terminology—"Best Motion Picture" and similar variations. Since the question specifically asks for the "Best Film" award by name, BAFTA in February 2024 appears to be the first major ceremony where Oppenheimer won under that exact title.

arguments.content: Oppenheimer first won the Best Film award at the 77th BAFTA Film Awards, held on February 18, 2024. (The Oscars, which came later on March 10, 2024, call the equivalent award "Best Picture.")

content.text: **Oppenheimer** first won **Best Film** at the **77th BAFTA Film Awards** (February 18, 2024). That ceremony — which uses the "Best Film" title — preceded the Academy Awards (where it won Best Picture) by about three weeks.
